page.layout: One printed page of text in a single column. Running head at the top, page number 112 at the head left. Catchword at the right foot. No marginal notes. Show-through from the facing page in the right and left margins, not transcribed.

main_text.p: poscit. Pantomime Scholas nostras deserito: Commenta, quae intuleras, efferto: In patriam, ad Parnassum quantocyus remigrato. Habet: Abitum maturat, & excerpit, quibus abundè libros nostros infarserat, paginas: Quanta struesjam nunc! ut, cum loquimur, accessione perpetuâ crescit! ut porro crescet! Itaque bajulos conducat sibi, aut agitatorem cum plaustro: ne si ipse humeris subeat, farcinae suae succumbat tenebrus. Interea, cum haec parantur,
Prodeat in judicium Mango, ornatus & harmoniae Genius. Adest ecce: Minio

page.notes: The catchword "ei &" sits alone at the right below the last line and is treated as a catchword. The faint marks on the left and right edges are show-through and were left out. The line "Genius. Adest ecce" carries underlining in the scan, not transcribed as formatting. Some letters in "struesjam" and "perpetuâ" are read as printed; the run-together "struesjam" may be a printing spacing error.
